get.summary: Get the data for a document from document management

parameters.name: auditableItemGraphDocumentId
parameters.description: The full id of the document to get.

parameters.name: includeBlobStorageMetadata
parameters.description: Include the blob storage metadata in the response.

parameters.name: includeBlobStorageData
parameters.description: Include the blob storage data in the response.

parameters.name: includeAttestation
parameters.description: Include the attestation information in the response.

parameters.name: includeRemoved
parameters.description: Include deleted documents in the response.

parameters.name: extractRuleGroupId
parameters.description: If provided will extract data from the document using the specified rule group id.

parameters.name: extractMimeType
parameters.description: By default extraction will auto detect the mime type of the document, this can be used to override the detection.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: PLimit the number of items to return, defaults to 1 so only most recent is returned.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor to get the next chunk of revisions.

200.description: Response to get a document and optionally revisions from an auditable item graph vertex.

UnitMeasureCode.description: RDF Class for UnitMeasureType unit code type to define unit code values.

appropriateClothing.description: Appropriate clothing, expressed as text, for this specified usage condition.

description.description: A textual description of this specified usage condition.

duration.description: A duration, expressed as text, for this specified usage condition.

genderLimitation.description: A gender limitation, expressed as text, for this specified usage condition.

occupancy.description: Occupancy, expressed as text, for this specified usage condition.

requiringParty.description: A party requiring this specified usage condition.

UsageCondition.description: The particular state of something, affected by use, that should be respected.

applicableIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this experience item voucher is applicable.

description.description: A textual description of this experience item voucher.

faceAmount.description: A monetary value shown on the face of this experience item voucher.

identifier.description: The identifier for this experience item voucher.

issueDateTime.description: The date or date time of the issuance of this experience item voucher.

issuingCompanyName.description: A name, expressed as text, of the company issuing this experience item voucher.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of experience item voucher.

applicableProcessCertificate.description: A process certificate applicable to this waste material recovery disposal process.

description.description: A textual description of a waste material recovery disposal process.
